senses.gloss: (in Babli), בּוּבְיָא, בּוּבְיָה (in Y.) f. (onomatop., v. Fl. to Levy Chald. Dict. I, 419 a. Fried. Del. Assyr. Stud. I, 142; v., however, בָּבִיתָא) reflected image in metal, water &c.; image, shadow.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 9b:6">Ned. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ונסתכלתי בבב׳ שלי</he> (Ar. with two <cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>, corr. acc.) and I was looking at my image (in the water); <cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 4:7">Tosef. Naz. IV, 7</cite> (Var. <cite ref="B00204"><he>בוביא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 1:1:14">Y. Ned. I, 36ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>בובייה</he>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <cite ref="B00204"><he>בוביא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 122a:9">Yeb. 122ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ דב׳</he> a shadow of a shadow.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 47a:18">Ab. Zar. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>לב׳ קא סגיד</he> he worships the image (in the water).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4:4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite> <he>ב׳ גדולה</he> magnified image.
<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 3:8">Treat. Sof’rim. III, 8</cite> <he>ב׳ שלו</he> the outlines of an effaced letter.
